verdict.rationale: Jira is an issue-tracking and work-management product, not a coding agent or execution environment, so auto-detecting and installing toolchains for a task is outside its product category. The evidence only shows Jira assigning work to external coding agents ('your favorite coding agent') and exposing context via MCP/CLI. Nothing shows Jira itself running an agent that installs dependencies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have a coding agent auto-detect and install the toolchains and dependencies it needs for a task
